1274516160944496640.a: People complaining #Starlink is almost $100/mo for Gbit service. When people talk about privilege this is what they mean. Here $100/mo buys you 50Mbit if you live in a low income neighborhood while Gbit fiber is $100/mo if you live in a wealthy area or near an industrial park.

1274516164375445510.a: One Starlink base station could provide service to a small town or a neighborhood for the price it currently costs one home to get bare minimum broadband in poor areas. If your internet is cheap it's likely because you're privileged by virtue of where you can afford to live.
